title: Real dinosaurs or not?
keyIdea: Dinosaurs were reptiles that walked on land, with their legs held straight under the body, and they lived from about 230 million to 66 million years ago. Some animals that lived at the same time were not dinosaurs: pterosaurs such as Pteranodon were flying reptiles, and plesiosaurs and ichthyosaurs were sea reptiles with flippers. Animals from other times were not dinosaurs either: Dimetrodon lived before the first dinosaurs, and woolly mammoths were furry mammals that lived long after them, at the same time as people. No person ever saw a living T. rex. Films and cartoons often get dinosaurs wrong: the real Velociraptor was about the size of a turkey and had feathers. Fossils, not films, tell us what dinosaurs were like. Birds came from small feathered dinosaurs.
familyTip: Next time you read a dinosaur book or watch a dinosaur film, play 'Dinosaur or not?'. For each animal, ask: did it walk on land, were its legs under its body, and did it live in dinosaur times? If it flies with skin wings, swims with flippers or has fur, it is not a dinosaur.

visual.caption: Was it a dinosaur? Drag each card into a box, or tap it and then a box.

lab.caption: Flagship lab: spot the animals that are not dinosaurs, fix a dinosaur's legs, put animals in time order, and sort film myths from fossil facts.

kid: Dinosaurs lived a long, long time ago. They walked on land. Their legs went straight down under the body, like the legs of a table. A lizard's legs stick out to the side.

Some animals from long ago were not dinosaurs. Pteranodon flew in the sky. It was a flying reptile. Plesiosaurus swam in the sea with flippers. It was a sea reptile. A woolly mammoth had fur. It was a mammal, like an elephant.
The big dinosaurs died out long before there were any people. No person ever saw a living T. rex. People did see woolly mammoths.
Films and cartoons are made up. In films, Velociraptor is as tall as a man. The real one was about as big as a turkey, and it had feathers. We find out what is real from fossils.
adult: Ages 5 to 7. This builds on 'dinosaurs were real' and on fossils as evidence. It links to Key Stage 1 science in England: identify and compare animals, and sort them by simple features. Year 3 Rocks and fossils comes next. Key words: dinosaur, reptile, pterosaur, plesiosaur, mammal, fossil, extinct.

Scientists decide what is a dinosaur from its bones and its family tree. Three checks work well for young children. Did it live on land? Were its legs straight under the body? Did it live in dinosaur times, about 230 to 66 million years ago? Pterosaurs and sea reptiles lived then too, but they were not dinosaurs. Birds came from small feathered dinosaurs, so scientists count birds as dinosaurs today.

Common mistakes: calling every big or old animal a dinosaur, such as Pteranodon, plesiosaurs, Dimetrodon and mammoths. Many children think people lived with dinosaurs, as cartoons show. Others take films as fact, such as a Velociraptor as tall as a man. Velociraptor arm bones have small bumps where feathers were fixed.

In the lab, children tap the animals in a long-ago scene that are not dinosaurs. They drag a dinosaur's feet in from a lizard-like sprawl, and put Dimetrodon, T. rex, mammoths and people in time order. Then they sort film myths from fossil facts and run the three checks on Stegosaurus, Dimetrodon and Ichthyosaurus.

practice.prompt: Real dinosaurs or not? Pteranodon flew in the sky. Was it a dinosaur?
choices: No, it was a flying reptile
Yes, all old animals are dinosaurs
practice.hint: Dinosaurs walked on land. What did Pteranodon do?
practice.explain: Pteranodon was a pterosaur, a flying reptile. Pterosaurs lived at the same time as dinosaurs, but they were not dinosaurs.

practice.prompt: A dinosaur book has {d} pictures of dinosaurs and {f} pictures of flying reptiles. How many pictures are not of dinosaurs?
practice.hint: Flying reptiles, like Pteranodon, are not dinosaurs. Count only those.
practice.explain: The {f} flying reptiles are not dinosaurs, so {f} pictures are not of dinosaurs. The {d} dinosaur pictures do not count.

choices: Legs out to the side, like a lizard
practice.hint: Think of the legs of a table.
practice.explain: A dinosaur's legs went straight down under its body. A lizard's legs stick out to the side, and flippers are for swimming.

practice.prompt: A museum has {d} dinosaur skeletons, {s} sea reptile skeletons and {m} mammoth skeletons. How many are real dinosaurs?
practice.hint: Sea reptiles and mammoths are not dinosaurs. Count only the dinosaurs.
practice.explain: Only the {d} dinosaur skeletons are dinosaurs. Sea reptiles swam with flippers, and mammoths were furry mammals.

practice.prompt: Did people ever see a living T. rex?
practice.hint: The big dinosaurs died out long, long ago. When did people come?
practice.explain: The big dinosaurs died out 66 million years ago. People came much, much later. Films are made up.

pool.prompt: Plesiosaurus swam in the sea with flippers. Was it a dinosaur?
choices: No, it was a sea reptile
pool.hint: Dinosaurs walked on land. Where did Plesiosaurus live?
pool.explain: Plesiosaurus was a sea reptile. It lived at the same time as dinosaurs, but it was not a dinosaur.

pool.prompt: A woolly mammoth had fur and tusks. Was it a dinosaur?
pool.hint: Dinosaurs were reptiles. Do reptiles have fur?
pool.explain: A woolly mammoth was a mammal, like an elephant. It lived long after the dinosaurs, at the same time as people.

pool.prompt: In a film, Velociraptor is as tall as a man. How big was the real one?
choices: About as big as a turkey
pool.hint: Films are made up. What do the fossils show?
pool.explain: Velociraptor fossils show it was about the size of a turkey, and it had feathers.

pool.prompt: Which one was a real dinosaur?
pool.hint: Look for the one that walked on land.
pool.explain: Stegosaurus walked on land with its legs under its body. Pteranodon flew and Plesiosaurus swam. They were not dinosaurs.

pool.prompt: Dimetrodon had a big sail on its back. It lived before the first dinosaurs. Was it a dinosaur?
choices: Yes, it was a reptile-like animal
pool.hint: Did it live in dinosaur times?
pool.explain: Dimetrodon lived before the first dinosaurs, and its legs stuck out to the side. It was not a dinosaur.

pool.prompt: A cartoon shows people riding on dinosaurs. Is that real?
pool.hint: Did people and big dinosaurs live at the same time?
pool.explain: It is made up. People came millions of years after the big dinosaurs died out.

pool.prompt: How do scientists find out what dinosaurs were really like?
pool.hint: What do scientists dig up from rocks?
pool.explain: Fossils, such as bones, teeth and footprints, show what dinosaurs were like. Films and cartoons are made up.

pool.prompt: A picture shows {d} dinosaurs on land and {p} Pteranodons in the sky. How many dinosaurs are in the picture?
pool.hint: Pteranodons are flying reptiles, not dinosaurs. Count only the ones on land.
pool.explain: There are {d} dinosaurs. The {p} Pteranodons are flying reptiles, so they do not count.

pool.prompt: Ichthyosaurus lived in dinosaur times. It swam in the sea with flippers. Was it a dinosaur?
choices: No, it lived in the sea
Yes, it lived in dinosaur times
pool.hint: A dinosaur must pass every check. Did it walk on land?
pool.explain: Ichthyosaurus fails the land check. It was a sea reptile, so it was not a dinosaur.

pool.prompt: A cartoon shows {d} dinosaurs and {m} woolly mammoths. How many of the animals are not dinosaurs?
pool.hint: Woolly mammoths had fur. They were mammals. Count only the mammoths.
pool.explain: The {m} woolly mammoths are mammals, not dinosaurs. So {m} of the animals are not dinosaurs.
